introduction: Oregon Health Plan enrollment is open year-round. Apply through ONE, by telephone or with the paper form linked by the health authority.
description: Oregon Health Plan enrollment is open year-round. Apply through ONE, by telephone or with the paper form linked by the health authority.

sections.who: The state checks household circumstances and coverage eligibility. Oregon says people of any age or immigration status may qualify; an application determines the individual result.
sections.get: OHP covers eligible medical, dental, prescription and behavioral healthcare without member charges under the state’s described benefits.

sections.apply:
1. Start your application

    Use OHP’s application page or call ONE at 800-699-9075.

  2. Submit household details

    Identify each person seeking coverage and answer follow-up requests.

  3. Read coverage instructions

    Review the approval, coverage dates and member information before arranging care.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and respond to renewal notices. Confirm provider participation when making appointments.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using OHP eligibility overview, services and intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Must I wait for fall enrollment?
No. OHP applications are accepted throughout the year.
Can I apply without the website?
Yes. The state lists telephone and paper application options.
Does immigration status automatically rule someone out?
Oregon says people of any immigration status may qualify; other eligibility conditions still apply.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
